review_scope: independent Linux/A2 lane re-validation of PR #61 exact head

cpu_only_build_vulkan_off.note: Portable standalone build is unchanged with Vulkan OFF; no new target, no new link-time dependency.

fail_closed.note: With VK_ICD_FILENAMES pointed at a non-existent ICD, a --gpu-required run exits 1 (hard failure) and an optional run exits 77 (CTest SKIP_RETURN_CODE). The GPU path never silently falls back to the CPU.

validation_layer_evidence.gpu_assisted_validation: layer-internal disable (GPU-AV self-disabled with an internal error under Vulkan 1.4.309 loader + layer 1.3.277); not an application or codec defect. Core validation checks remained active for the whole run.
validation_layer_evidence.method: User-level layer manifest under the per-user Vulkan explicit_layer.d directory plus VK_LAYER_PATH; enabled per-run via VK_INSTANCE_LAYERS. No root, no system change, and no repository code change was required.

resource_ownership_review.method: static review of src/vulkan/vulkan_frontend.cpp at the exact head, plus the validation-layer run above
findings: Every device resource (VkBuffer/VkDeviceMemory, VkShaderModule, VkDescriptorSetLayout, VkPipelineLayout, VkPipeline) is created per call and destroyed in both the success and exception paths; the Buffer/Pipeline helpers destroy before reuse.

Per-dispatch VkDescriptorSet and VkCommandBuffer are allocated from pools with a single queue, then freed after vkQueueWaitIdle, so both pools are reused across the long parity run instead of exhausting (descriptor pool maxSets 256, VK_DESCRIPTOR_POOL_CREATE_FREE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_BIT set).
vkCmdResetQueryPool is recorded between vkBeginCommandBuffer and vkEndCommandBuffer (the bring-up defect 1 fix); timestamps are gated on timestampValidBits and optional entry-point availability.
Destructor order: query pool, descriptor pool, command pool, device, instance - no use-after-free of the device-bound pools.
Instance destruction for the discovery path (DiscoverDevice/IsAvailable) is correctly paired; no leaked VkInstance per probe.
resource_ownership_review.device_selection: VK_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_TYPE_DISCRETE_GPU > INTEGRATED_GPU > other; a CPU-type device is only chosen when no GPU has a compute queue.

explicitly_not_claimed: No CFHD bitstream compatibility or production encoder claim.
No throughput/performance claim; P1 uses host-visible buffers, so wall time is transfer-dominated.
No L2/L3, quantization, entropy or framing.
No GPU-assisted (shader instrumentation) validation coverage - only Vulkan core validation.
No merge to main; PR #61 remains Draft and is a maintainer decision.

artifacts.note: Raw build/logs remain outside Git; this JSON carries the reproducible summary, counts, exit codes and hashes.
